 How Polymarket Sign-Up Bonus Code SBWIRE Works
 The $50 Polymarket signup code is reserved for new accounts, and the terms are refreshingly light. Two conditions unlock it: you enter Polymarket invite code SBWIRE when you create your account, and your first deposit clears at $10 or more. Once both are met, the $25 hits your balance immediately and can be spent on any market category Polymarket offers.
 The one detail worth underlining is timing. The code has to be applied while you are registering. Polymarket cannot attach it to an account after the fact, so a missed code means a forfeited bonus. Enter SBWIRE up front and the offer takes care of itself.
 How to Claim the Polymarket Sign-Up Bonus
 Claiming the Polymarket sign-up bonus SBWIRE offer takes just a few minutes.
 Download the Polymarket app or open the web interface, then start a new registration.
 Create your account with an email address or Google login and enter code SBWIRE when prompted during sign-up.
 Confirm your identity with a government-issued ID.
 Make a first deposit of at least $10. The $25 bonus is credited right away.
 What Is Polymarket?
 Polymarket is not a sportsbook. Rather than betting against a house that sets the lines, you trade contracts tied to real-world events, from election results and economic data to crypto price levels and pop-culture outcomes.
 Each market is framed as a single yes-or-no question, and a contract's price reflects the crowd's read on how likely that outcome is. Picture a market asking whether a particular NFL team making the playoffs, with "Yes" shares trading at $0.60. That price implies traders collectively put the odds near 60%.
 A share that resolves in your favor pays out $1, while the losing side returns nothing. Because you can buy or sell a position any time before a market settles, you are free to trade around momentum and shifting sentiment instead of being locked in.
 Where the Polymarket Sign-Up Bonus Is Available
 Polymarket operates in the United States through QCEX, a CFTC-registered exchange, which gives the platform far more regulatory standing than it carried in its earlier years. Settlement happens on the Polygon blockchain in USDC, a dollar-pegged stablecoin, so every trade is transparent and verifiable on-chain.
 The Polymarket sign-up bonus is live in 49 states plus Washington, D.C., with Nevada the exclusion. Keep in mind that prediction markets sit in a fast-moving regulatory space, and Polymarket has active legal and regulatory matters that could change availability or features down the line. Read the platform's current terms before you deposit. You must be 18 or older and clear identity verification to trade.
 Start Trading With the Polymarket Sign-Up Bonus Today
 Polymarket sits at the intersection of trading, data and live current events, and few welcome offers make that easier to explore. Enter code SBWIRE , deposit $10, collect your $25 Polymarket sign-up bonus and start working the markets that interest you most.
 Polymarket Sign-Up Bonus FAQs
 How do I claim the Polymarket sign-up bonus?
 Register through the Polymarket app or web interface, enter code SBWIRE during sign-up and make a first deposit of at least $10 to claim the Polymarket sign-up bonus. The $25 bonus is credited to your balance immediately. The code has to be entered while you register to qualify.
 How much is the Polymarket sign-up bonus worth?
 New users receive a $25 bonus after depositing $10 or more with code SBWIRE. The Polymarket sign-up bonus is usable across any market the moment it lands.
 Is Polymarket legal in the U.S.?
 Polymarket operates through QCEX, a CFTC-registered exchange, and is available in every state except Nevada. The regulatory picture for prediction markets is still developing, so check the platform's terms for the latest details in your state.
 When do I need to enter code SBWIRE?
 The code must be applied during registration. It cannot be added once an account exists. After you sign up and deposit at least $10, the $25 bonus appears in your account right away.
 Does the Polymarket sign-up bonus have a rollover requirement?
 The $25 Polymarket sign-up bonus requires just a 1x playthrough. Once it is credited, you can use it on any eligible market without clearing a wagering threshold first and collect and winnings from success predictions.
